acceptance: make apicover (warning-only) never leaves a scoped profile under the name coverage.txt that the coverage gates read
A test runs make apicover, then cover-strict and cover-changed, and the gates refuse or ignore the scoped profile

consumed.resolution: Fixed in PR #861 (plan T2): make apicover writes coverage.apicover.txt; TestMakeApicover_NeverFeedsTheCoverageGates proves no gate reads it.

fix: Write the warning-only apicover report profile to its own name (for example coverage.apicover-report.txt), as apicover-enforce already does with coverage.apicover.txt.
summary: LOW: make apicover writes coverage.txt from a scoped run. After T2 every coverage gate reads coverage.txt as the one profile of a green test-integration run, so a scoped profile under that name can feed partial numbers to a gate (freshness still passes).
title: make apicover writes a scoped profile under the gate's name coverage.txt
